title: Moving characters in party without using an event sprite?

posts.author: Lady_Elva
posts.body:
Hello, I have a question for someone who may know the answer. Is there a way to take control or control party members in a scene without having to have them leave the party, create an event with their sprite and then rejoin with their event sprites gone? I'm trying to make 2 other members in my party face up without having to make more events on the map I have in a castle throne room. If it's not feasible, I can understand and will go the longer route I mentioned. I was just wondering if there was an easier way to do it or a plug-in I can use.
Thank you for taking the time to read this.

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
im assuming you mean followers, right? instead of removing the party members, you could turn off the followers at the start of the event, have your events for the party members appear on the map behind the leader, and then once your cutscene is over, hide the party member events and reenable the followers.
other than that, youd need some plugin to control the followers. I know theres a few for MV, but visustella has a utility for it in their events and movement plugin for MZ

posts.author: Zia_
posts.body:
You can use this Script.
Code:
$gamePlayer.followers().follower(0).setDirection(8); // for PartyMember 2
$gamePlayer.followers().follower(1).setDirection(8); // for PartyMember 3
